phrase.en: the appointment of a new director

deadline.rule: File ND2A within 15 days after the appointment

steps.label: Screen against sanctions and PEP lists
File ND2A with the Companies Registry

documents.name: Board written resolution: appointment of director
Form ND2A: appointment, with consent to act

complianceNotes: File ND2A within 15 days after the appointment takes effect.
The appointee signs the consent to act on ND2A itself, so ND2A goes out in the e-signature pack.
A private company must keep at least one individual director, and individual directors must be 18 or over.
Complete customer due diligence and screening before the appointment takes effect.
If the new director will hold over 25% or otherwise control the company, update the significant controllers register too.
appointDirector.resolutionTemplate: m=>'THAT '+personName(m)+' be appointed as a director of the Company with effect from '+V(m,'effDate')+'.'

deadline.rule: File ND2A within 15 days after the resignation

steps.label: Check the board still meets minimum requirements
File ND2A with the Companies Registry
Confirm to client and remind about bank mandates

documents.name: Board written resolution: resignation of director

complianceNotes: File ND2A within 15 days after the resignation takes effect.
The resigning director may also notify the Registrar directly using Form ND4.
Check the company still has at least one individual director after the resignation. If not, a replacement must be appointed at the same time.
Remind the client to update bank signatories and any authorisations the director held.
resignDirector.resolutionTemplate: m=>'THAT the resignation of '+personName(m)+' as a director of the Company with effect from '+V(m,'lastDay')+' be accepted and noted.'
resignDirector.sampleClientReply:

Replacement: not needed, LAM Mei Ling stays on as director
[Attachment: resignation_letter_lam.pdf]

phrase.en: the change in an officer's details

deadline.rule: File ND2B within 15 days after the change

steps.label: File ND2B with the Companies Registry

complianceNotes: File ND2B within 15 days after the change in particulars.

Only the correspondence address and a partial ID number appear on the public register. The residential address and full ID number are protected information, but must still be kept in the company’s records.
A new passport or address also refreshes our KYC record, so update the CDD file at the same time.
changeParticulars.resolutionTemplate: m=>'THAT the change in particulars of '+personName(m)+' ('+V(m,'changeDetail')+') be noted.'
changeParticulars.sampleClientReply:
Hi Karen, I renewed my passport last week.
Change: passport number changed from P1234567 to P7654321, issued by Hong Kong SAR
Effective date: 15 September 2026
[Attachment: new_passport_ho.jpg]

deadline.rule: File ND2A within 15 days after the change

steps.label: File ND2A with the Companies Registry

documents.name: Board written resolution: change of secretary
Form ND2A: secretary appointment and cessation

complianceNotes: File ND2A within 15 days after the change.
An individual secretary must ordinarily reside in Hong Kong. A corporate secretary must have its registered office or a place of business in Hong Kong.
In a private company, a sole director cannot also be the company secretary.
Corporate secretaries providing this as a business need a TCSP licence.
changeSecretary.resolutionTemplate: m=>'THAT '+V(m,'secDetails')+' be appointed as company secretary of the Company with effect from '+V(m,'effDate')+'.'
changeSecretary.sampleClientReply:

Effective date: 1 November 2026
[Attachment: resignation_outgoing_secretary.pdf]

deadline.rule: File NR1 within 15 days after the change

steps.label: File NR1 with the Companies Registry
Send the client a list of places to update

documents.name: Board written resolution: change of registered office
Form NR1: change of address of registered office
Checklist: letterhead, signboard, bank, website, invoices

complianceNotes: File NR1 within 15 days after the change.
The registered office must be an address in Hong Kong. A PO box is not accepted.
Check current Companies Registry guidance on whether NR1 also updates the Business Registration Office record, and notify IRD separately if not.
The company name must be displayed at the new office.
changeOffice.resolutionTemplate: m=>'THAT the registered office of the Company be changed to '+V(m,'newAddr')+' with effect from '+V(m,'effDate')+'.'
changeOffice.sampleClientReply:
New address: 23/F, Cityplaza One, 1111 King's Road, Taikoo Shing, Hong Kong
Effective date: 1 November 2026
[Attachment: tenancy_agreement_cityplaza.pdf]

deadline.rule: File NNC2 within 15 days after the special resolution

steps.label: File NNC2 with the Companies Registry
Record the certificate of change of name
Update registers, chop and business registration

documents.name: Members’ special resolution: change of name
Form NNC2: notice of change of company name
Checklist: company chop, seal, signboard, bank, contracts

complianceNotes: The change needs a special resolution of members, and NNC2 must be filed within 15 days after it is passed.
The new name only takes effect when the Registrar issues the certificate of change of name.
Search the Companies Registry index before the resolution is signed, and hold a backup name.
A new company chop and common seal (if any) will be needed.
changeName.resolutionTemplate: m=>'THAT, subject to the approval of the Registrar of Companies, the name of the Company be changed to '+V(m,'newName')+'.'
changeName.sampleClientReply:
New name: Silverstrand Capital Limited / 銀線灣資本有限公司 (backup: Silverstrand Group Limited)
Approval: written resolution, both shareholders will sign

steps.label: Complete CDD, screening and risk rating
Record certificate of incorporation and BR certificate
Set up registers, SCR and share certificates

documents.name: Form NNC1, with business registration application
Registers of members, directors and significant controllers

complianceNotes: NNC1 is filed together with the business registration application, so both certificates issue together.
A private company needs at least one individual director and a company secretary resident in Hong Kong.
CDD on all founders, directors and significant controllers must be completed before we act.
Set up the significant controllers register from day one, and designate a person to deal with enforcement officers.

phrase.en: moving your company secretarial services to us

steps.label: Complete CDD, screening and risk rating

documents.name: Board written resolution: appoint secretary, change registered office
Form NR1: change of registered office

complianceNotes: Reconcile the handed-over registers against a fresh company search before relying on them.
Check whether the annual return, SCR and business registration are up to date. Gaps become the client’s first matters.
CDD on directors and significant controllers must be completed before we act.

deadline.rule: Private company: within 42 days after the anniversary of incorporation

steps.label: File NAR1 and pay the fee

complianceNotes: A private company files NAR1 within 42 days after each anniversary of incorporation.
Late filing attracts a higher registration fee that increases with delay, and can lead to prosecution.
Any unreported changes found during confirmation should be opened as their own matters first.
annualReturn.sampleClientReply: No changes since last year, thanks. 冇變動。

phrase.en: the annual accounts approval and AGM

deadline.rule: Private company: within 9 months after the end of the accounting reference period

documents.name: Board resolution approving financial statements and directors’ report
Members’ written resolutions in lieu of AGM

complianceNotes: A private company holds its AGM within 9 months after its accounting reference period ends.
Members can pass a written resolution instead of meeting, or unanimously agree to dispense with AGMs.
The auditor must be reappointed each year unless the members resolve otherwise.
agm.resolutionTemplate: m=>'THAT the audited financial statements and directors\u2019 report for the latest financial year be approved, and '+V(m,'auditor')+' be reappointed as auditor.'
agm.sampleClientReply:
Audited accounts attached.
Auditor: reappoint Wong & Partners CPA Limited, same fee as last year
Approval: written resolution please
[Attachment: audited_financial_statements_FY2025.pdf]

deadline.rule: Renew before the current certificate expires

steps.label: Pay the fee or forward the demand note

complianceNotes: IRD normally issues a demand note before expiry. Track the expiry date here rather than relying on the post.
Renewal can be for 1 or 3 years.
Branch registrations are renewed together with the main certificate.

phrase.en: our periodic client due diligence review

deadline.rule: Firm policy: high risk yearly, medium every 2 years, low every 3 years

steps.label: Re-screen against sanctions and PEP lists
Review and update the risk rating

complianceNotes: Review frequency here follows a sample firm policy. Set it to match your own AML policies and procedures.
Keep CDD records for at least 5 years after the business relationship ends.
A change in significant controllers found here should also update the SCR.
